ProgramDayActivityConditionSchema.title: ProgramDayActivityConditionSchema

ProgramDayCreateSchema.description:
Schema for adding a day to a program from the app.

Adds ``scheduled_dates``, the replace-all set of explicit occurrence dates
(program_day_occurrence_schedules), and ``activity_conditions``, the replace-all set of
activities the day asks for. Agent proposals extend the base schema, so their reviewed
contract is unchanged and they schedule dates one at a time.
ProgramDayCreateSchema.title: ProgramDayCreateSchema

ProgramDayGoalAttachSchema.description: Schema for attaching a goal to a program day.
ProgramDayGoalAttachSchema.title: ProgramDayGoalAttachSchema

ProgramDayOccurrenceMoveSchema.description: Move one occurrence, replacing any occurrence at its destination.
ProgramDayOccurrenceMoveSchema.title: ProgramDayOccurrenceMoveSchema

ProgramDayOccurrenceUnscheduleSchema.title: ProgramDayOccurrenceUnscheduleSchema

ProgramDayOrderSchema.description: Every program day of a program, in the order the user arranged them.
ProgramDayOrderSchema.title: ProgramDayOrderSchema

ProgramDayScheduleSchema.description:
Schedule a reusable program day onto one calendar date.

``date`` is canonical. ``session_start`` is accepted for one release so
existing agent proposals keep validating; its date part is used.
ProgramDayScheduleSchema.title: ProgramDayScheduleSchema

ProgramDaySessionCreditSchema.description: Credit, exclude, or restore automatic attribution of a session on one date.
ProgramDaySessionCreditSchema.title: ProgramDaySessionCreditSchema

ProgramDayStatusesUpdateSchema.description: Atomically set or clear manual statuses for scheduled program dates.
ProgramDayStatusesUpdateSchema.title: ProgramDayStatusesUpdateSchema

ProgramDayTemplateConfigSchema.description: Completion metadata for a session template attached to a program day.
ProgramDayTemplateConfigSchema.title: ProgramDayTemplateConfigSchema

ProgramDayUpdateSchema.description:
Schema for updating a program day from the app.

Adds ``scheduled_dates``, the replace-all set of explicit occurrence dates
(program_day_occurrence_schedules), and ``activity_conditions``, the replace-all set of
activities the day asks for. Agent proposals extend the base schema, so their reviewed
contract is unchanged and they schedule dates one at a time.
ProgramDayUpdateSchema.title: ProgramDayUpdateSchema

ProgramGoalDeadlineSchema.description: Schema for setting a goal deadline through program calendar semantics.
ProgramGoalDeadlineSchema.title: ProgramGoalDeadlineSchema

ProgramSessionPlanPullSchema.description: Pull a template's current sections into a plan, keeping its planned values.
ProgramSessionPlanPullSchema.title: ProgramSessionPlanPullSchema

ProgramSessionPlanSaveSchema.description:
Replace-all save of one dated plan's sections.

``row_version`` is the version the edit started from; omit it only when the plan
was still a virtual seed. Item-level shape and planned values are validated by the
plan service, which also checks them against the activity definitions.
ProgramSessionPlanSaveSchema.title: ProgramSessionPlanSaveSchema

ProgressChartSchema.description: The Progress pane chart for an activity in the instance's template/program day.

ProgressComparisonSchema.description: What one activity instance compares against.

PublicTelemetryEventSchema.title: PublicTelemetryEventSchema

QuickSessionCompleteSchema.description:
A quick session, logged on the device and created already complete.

It has no template, program or goals: only the activities logged, in order. Older clients'
queued completions also send template and session fields; they are accepted and ignored.
QuickSessionCompleteSchema.title: QuickSessionCompleteSchema
